title: Community safety partnerships, December 2023 (England and Wales, generalised, clipped)
description: Community safety partnership areas, the geography ONS reports police recorded crime against in Table C2 of the police force area tables.

files.note: Exported from the Open Geography Portal feature service "Community_Safety_Partnerships_December_2023_Boundaries_EW_BGC" (https://services1.arcgis.com/ESMARspQHYMw9BZ9/arcgis/rest/services/Community_Safety_Partnerships_December_2023_Boundaries_EW_BGC/FeatureServer/0/query?where=1%3D1&outFields=*&outSR=4326&f=geojson), 314 features in WGS84.
